notes.title: UPDATE: 0.7.0.0 - Alpha
notes.content:
[u]Dev notes[/u]
I am happy to announce Wandering Star is now officially in ALPHA! With this update comes mostly cleanup but some new feature too. Balancing was done in order to make the game truly "winable" it was to begin with, but even on easy it felt like Nightmare mode. Next few updates will be about polishing up what is currently added, along with new abilities and skills for each class.


[i][b]==PATCH NOTES==[/b][/i]

[u]MAJOR[/u]
Main menu overhaul rework. Redid all code, now can also use controller.
With the rework to the main menu, game is officially 'full controller support'.
Many new sounds have been added as placeholders for official sounds in the future. 

[u]FIXED[/u]
Cleaned up player bullet effects.
All parts now correctly add onto the ship according to the part found.
Fixed the Level 4 door not playing the 'standby' animation.
No longer able to build the Extractor with you under it.
Bullet spawning from player, drone and turret have been cleaned up.

[u]CHANGED[/u]
Enemy power curve for later game has been lowered.
Part requirements to be found has been lowered on all levels.
Increased Turret range for level 1.
When putting parts on the ground, places them based on the grid.
Better collision detection for building when a player or building is on the same tile.
Easier to see controls in the player select screen.
Resource movement for collecting and storage now is on bumpers instead of Dpad.
Enemies do much more damage early game.

[u]NEW[/u]
Detect if Player 1 is mouse or keyboard based on what is used in the main menu.
Sounds that have been added-
    - Mining Rock, Copper, and Obsidian.
    - Rock and Obsidian breaking.
    - Placing a wall/door.
    - Repairing a building.
    - Installing a part in the ship.

[u]Known Bugs[/u]
Trying to play 2/3 player, without using the player 2/3 controller.
Use controller for Player 1 when playing multiplayer, mouse not working right. (WIP to fix)
